clips.title: The story
paras: Eitrigg is a seasoned veteran of the First and Second Wars who stands beside Warchief Thrall as an esteemed advisor in Orgrimmar. Once a warrior of the Blackrock clan, he became disillusioned with the old demonic Horde and lived in exile until an extraordinary friendship with a human paladin changed his fate. Today, he helps guide the New Horde back to its roots of honor and shamanism.

Born on Draenor into the Blackrock clan, Eitrigg fought for the Horde through the First and Second Wars. The horrific battles and the ultimate defeat of the Horde in the Second War forced him to confront how far his people had fallen to bloodlust and demonic corruption. Sickened by what the Horde had become, Eitrigg walked away from the scattered remnants and retreated into self-imposed exile, seeking only solitude in the wilds of Lordaeron.
